gemini.notes: Input has aria-label 'Enter a prompt for Gemini', role=textbox (Quill div.ql-editor.new-input-ui). Reset flow confirmed end-to-end: clicking the sidebar 'New chat' link opens a 'Clear current chat & create new one?' dialog; confirm button is [role='dialog'] button:has-text('New chat'). Works fully unauthenticated (no sign-in required to chat). Detected 2026-07-08.

claude.name: Claude

response_selectors.description: Full rendered message body for one assistant turn (excludes sr-only thinking-summary header); one element per turn so taking the last is correct
Completed assistant turn container (fallback; includes extra thinking-summary text mixed in)

BROKEN for multi-paragraph replies: matches one

PER PARAGRAPH across the ENTIRE conversation history, not scoped to the current turn, so picking the last element only returns the final sentence of the latest reply. Kept as last-resort fallback only.

reset_button.description: Claude logo link (href=/new) navigates to a fresh chat; more reliable than reload() which just refreshes the current chat URL (e.g. /chat/<id>) without starting a new conversation
